title: Expander attention as exchange-correlation
summary: Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) is the workhorse of quantum chemistry, offering an attractive balance between accuracy and computational cost. Although exact in principle, DFT in practice relies on an approximation to the unknown exchange-correlation (XC) functional, which encodes the many-body quantum effects beyond the mean-field treatment. Many such approximations exist, and machine-learned XC functionals have proliferated in recent years.
